spans.s:
विल् विल्, cl. 6. P. विलति, वेलितुम्, to
cover, conceal, clothe; to break or
divide, (in this sense more usually written बिल्); cl.
10. P. वेलयति, -यितुम्, to throw, cast, direct, send.

विल, अम्, n. an aperture, opening, hole, chasm,
vacuity; a burrow, cave, cavern, den; the vagina;
(अस्), m. one of Indra's horses; a sort of reed or
cane, Calamus Rotang.
—विल-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, mak-
ing holes, burrowing; (ई), m. a mouse.
—विलङ्-
गम, अस्, m. ‘hole-goer,’ a serpent, snake.
—वि-
ल-धावन, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. (sensu obsceno)
rimam tergens.
—विल-योनि, इस्, इस्, इ, of the breed
of Vila (said of horses).
—विल-वास, अस्, आ, अम्,
living in holes, burrowing; (अस्), m. an animal
which lives in holes; a polecat (= जाहक).
—विल-
वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, living in a hole, burrowing; (ई), m.
a snake.
—विल-शय, अस्, ई, अम्, living or burrowing
in holes; (अस्), m. any animal that lives in holes; a
snake.
—विल-शायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, lying in a hole, living
in holes; (ई), m. any animal that lives in holes.
—विले-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, living or burrowing in holes;
(ई), m. a snake.
—विले-शय, अस्, m. any animal
living in holes; a snake; a rat; a hare or rabbit;
N. of a teacher of the Haṭha-vidyā.
—विलेश्वर
(˚ल-ईश्˚), अस्, m., N. of a place of pilgrimage;
[]
(perhaps incorrectly for बिल्वेश्वर.)
—विलौकस्
(˚ल-ओक्˚), आस्, आस्, अस्, living in a hole; (आस्), m. any
animal that lives in holes.

विल्ल विल्ल, अम्, n. (probably connected with
विल), a pit, hole, a basin for water round the root
of a tree (= आलवाल); Asa Fetida.
—विल्ल-मूला,
f. a sort of yam (= वाराही).
विलस, अस्, आ, अम्, see Gaṇa Tṛṇādi to Pāṇ.

वि-लास, अस्, m. sport, pastime, play, merriness,
(especially) amorous pastime, diversion (with women,
dancers, singers, &c.), dalliance, coquetry, affecta-
tion of coyness, wantonness, (a form of feminine
gesture considered as indicative of amorous senti-
ments, such as change of place, posture, gait, look,
hiding at the approach of a lover, assuming a look
of displeasure, &c.); grace, elegance, charm, beauty.
—विलास-कानन, अम्, n. a pleasure-grove, pleasure-
ground.
—विलास-मन्दिर, अम्, n. a pleasure-house,
summer-house.
—विलास-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, sportive,
playful, dallying, wanton; (अती), f. a wanton or
coquettish woman.
—विलास-विभवानस (?), अस्,
आ, अम्, greedy, covetous.

विलक्ष् वि-लक्ष्, cl. 10. P. A. -लक्षयति,
-ते, -यितुम्, to distinguish, mark, characterize; to
observe, perceive, see, notice; to be without the
power of fixing the eye on any object, to become
bewildered or confused or embarrassed.

वि-लक्ष, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. लक्ष with वि in a
privative sense or expressing difference), markless,
unmarked, having no distinguishing mark or aim;
having no characteristic mark or property; having a
different mark, having a character different to what
is usual or natural, strange, extraordinary; bewildered,
embarrassed; astonished, surprised; abashed, ashamed.
—विलक्ष-ता, f. or विलक्ष-त्व, अम्, n. absence
of mark or aim, absence of distinguishing property;
confusion, bewilderment, surprise; shame.
—वि-
लक्षी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to make bewil-
dered or confused, scoff at, insult.
—विलक्षी-कृत,
अस्, आ, अम्, scoffed at, insulted.

1. वि-लक्षण, अम्, n. the act of distinguishing,
perceiving, seeing, observing.

2. वि-लक्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, having no distinguish-
ing marks; having different or opposite marks or
characteristics, having distinguishing qualities or
features, other, different, strange, extraordinary;
(अम्), n. any state or condition which is without
distinguishing mark or for which no cause can be
assigned, vain or causeless state.

1. वि-लक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, distinguished, marked,
recognised, discerned, perceived, seen, observed,
noticed, discernible by; perplexed, dismayed, dis-
concerted, affected without cause, embarrassed, puz-
zled, vexed, annoyed, disappointed.

2. वि-लक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, undistinguished, un-
discriminated, unmarked.

वि-लक्ष्य, ind. having perceived or noticed, hav-
ing observed; having become bewildered or confused.

विलग् वि-लग्, cl. 1. P. -लगति, &c., to
hang to, cling to, stick to, hold on to (with loc.).

वि-लगित, अस्, आ, अम्, attached to, &c., (but see
वि-लगित below.)

विलगित वि-लगित or वि-लङ्गित, referred
to rt. लङ्ग् with वि in Pāṇ.
Vārtt. 1

वि-लग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, clung to, clinging to, fastened
or attached to, resting on, fixed on, connected with;
brought close to; gone by, passed away; slender,
thin, delicate (said of the waist); (अम्), n. = लग्न,
the rising of constellations, a horoscope, &c.; the
waist, middle (as connecting the upper and lower
parts of the body).
—विलग्न-मध्या, f. a woman
with a slender waist.
वि-लग्य, ind. having clung to, having stuck to.

विलङ्घ् वि-लङ्घ्, cl. 1. P. A. -लङ्घति, -ते,
-लङ्घितुम्, to leap or spring about, jump, skip; cl.
10. P. or Caus. -लङ्घयति, -यितुम्, to leap or jump
over, overstep, pass over, pass or rise beyond, pass
by, transgress, violate, neglect, contemn; to over-
come, surmount, get the better of, surpass, excel,
frustrate; to rise towards, ascend to; to give up,
abandon; to act wrongly towards, offend; to cause
to pass over the right time for eating, cause to fast,
make to abstain from food.

वि-लङ्घन, अम्, n. the act of passing beyond,
transgressing, overstepping; striking against, trans-
gression, offence.

वि-लङ्घनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be overstepped or
passed over, to be transgressed.

वि-लङ्घयित्वा, anom. ind. part. having surpassed
or surmounted.

वि-लङ्घित, अस्, आ, अम्, overleaped, overstepped,
transgressed; overcome, surpassed, excelled.
—वि-
लङ्घिताकाश (˚त-आक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, passing or rising
beyond the sky.
वि-लङ्घिन्, ई, इनी, इ, transgressing, ascending to.

वि-लङ्घ्य, ind. having jumped or passed over,
having omitted or neglected.

विलज्ज् वि-लज्ज्, cl. 6. A. -लज्जते (some-
times also P. -लज्जति), -लज्जितुम्, to become ashamed
or abashed, feel ashamed, blush.

वि-लज्ज, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. लज्जा with वि in a priva-
tive sense), shameless, unabashed.

वि-लज्जत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, being ashamed,
feeling ashamed, modest, bashful.

वि-लज्जमान, अस्, आ, अम्, ashamed, abashed,
modest, blushing.
वि-लज्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, ashamed, abashed.

विलप् वि-लप्, cl. 1. P. A. -लपति, -ते, -ल-
पितुम्, -लप्तुम्, to wail, moan, weep, cry, utter
cries or lamentations, to mourn, bewail, lament (with
acc.), complain; to speak variously, talk much or
idly, prattle, chatter, talk (in general): Caus. -लाप-
यति, -यते, -यितुम्, to cause to mourn or lament;
to cause to speak much (A.).

वि-लपत्, अन्, अन्ती (ep. also अती), अत्, lamenting,
wailing, moaning, complaining; prating, talking idly
or wildly; talking, speaking.

वि-लपन, अम्, n. the act of lamenting, wailing,
complaining, &c.; chattering, talking idly or wildly;
talking; the dirt or sediment of any oily substance
(as of clarified butter &c.).
—विलपन-विनोद, अस्,
m. removing (grief) by weeping.

1. वि-लापन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. the Caus. of वि-लप्),
causing to bewail; (अम्), n. the act of causing to
lament; lamentation; (अस्), m. a proper N.

2. वि-लापन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. the Caus. of वि-ली),
causing to be dissolved, melting, &c.; causing to dis-
appear, destroying; (अम्), n. dissolution, death.

वि-लपमान, अस्, आ, अम्, lamenting, wailing,
weeping.

वि-लपित, अस्, आ, अम्, lamented, bewailed; chat-
tered; spoken idly, spoken; (अम्), n. lamentation,
wailing; a moan, wail.

वि-लापित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), caused to be
dissolved, liquefied.

वि-लपिष्यत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, about to lament
or bewail.

वि-लप्य, ind. having bewailed or lamented,
lamenting, bewailing.

वि-लप्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (ep. for वि-लपत्),
lamenting, bewailing.

वि-लाप, अस्, m. lamentation, crying, wailing,
moaning, complaint; a moan, wail, groan.

विलभ् वि-लभ्, cl. 1. A. -लभते, -लब्धुम्,
to take away, remove; to grant, bestow, provide;
to consign, hand over, deliver: Caus. -लम्भयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to receive or fall to the share of
9with double acc.): Desid. -लिप्सते, to desire to
take away, wish to share.

वि-लब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, taken away, taken; given,
bestowed, consigned.

वि-लम्भ, अस्, m. giving, gift, donation; libe-
rality.

विलम्ब् वि-लम्ब्, cl. 1. A. -लम्बते (ep.
also P. -लम्बति), -लम्बितुम्, to hang on both
sides (Ved.), hang down, hang on, hang to or from,
be attached to (with loc.); to sink, set, decline; to
continue hanging, linger, loiter, delay (e. g. मा वि-
लम्बस्व, do not delay), tarry, hesitate, procrasti-
nate: Pass. -लम्ब्यते, to be lingered or loitered,
to be delayed: Caus. -लम्बयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to
cause to linger or loiter, detain, delay; to spend un-
profitably, waste, lose; to put off, procrastinate; to
loiter, delay.

वि-लम्ब, अस्, m. hanging or falling down, pen-
dulousness; slowness, tardiness, delay, procrastina-
tion; N. of the sixth year of Jupiter's cycle.

वि-लम्बत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, hanging down, falling
down, delaying.

वि-लम्बन, अम्, n. hanging down or from, de-
pending; delaying, delay, procrastination, retarding.

वि-लम्बमान, अस्, आ, अम्, hanging down, hang-
ing from; hanging or suspended on; declining, set-
ting (said of the sun).
वि-लम्बिका, f. retardation of the feces, constipation.

वि-लम्बित, अस्, आ, अम्, hanging or falling down,
depending; pendulous; hanging on, closely con-
nected with or dependent on; retarded, procrasti-
nated, slow, tardy; slow (as time in music or in
chanting the Veda &c.; cf. वृत्ति); spent use-
lessly, wasted; (अम्), ind. slowly, tardily; (अम्), n.
[]
delay, (अ-विलम्बितम्, ind. without delay); (अस्,
अम्), m. n. slow time.
—विलम्बित-गति, इस्, इस्, इ,
slow or tardy in motion; epithet of a kind of metre.
—विलम्बित-फल, अस्, आ, अम्, having the fruit
or fulfilment delayed.

वि-लम्बिन्, ई, इनी, इ, hanging down or from, de-
pending, pendulous; delaying, retarding, dilatory,
slow; (ई), m. the thirty-second year of the Indian
cycle.

वि-लम्ब्य, ind. having lingered or loitered,
loitering, dallying, (अ-विलम्ब्य, without delay.)
विलय वि-लय, &c. See under वि-ली, p. 938.

वि-लय, अस्, m. dissolution, liquefaction, death,
destruction, destruction of the world, (विलयं गम्,
to be dissolved, to end.)
वि-लाय, ind. = वि-लीय, Pāṇ.

विलला वि-लला, f. (probably fr. rt. लल् with
वि), a sort of plant, Sida Cordifolia (= श्वेत-बला).

विलाल वि-लाल, अस्, m. (fr. rt. लल् with वि),
an instrument, machine (= यन्त्र); a cat, (in this
sense = विडाल, विराल, q. q. v. v.)

विलस् वि-लस्, cl. 1. P. -लसति, -लसितुम्, to
gleam, flash, glitter, shine; to shine forth, come to
light, appear, arise, be manifested; to play, sport, be
sportive or wanton, be amused or delighted; to jump
or frisk about, move about, dart, wave; to sound,
echo.

वि-लसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, flashing, shining, glitter-
ing, brilliant, beautiful, splendid; shining forth, ap-
pearing; playing, sporting, sportive, wanton; frisk-
ing or moving about, waving, darting, flashing (as
lightning); sounding, echoing.
—विलसत्-पताक,
अस्, आ, अम्, having a gleaming or waving flag.
—वि-
लसन्-मरीचि, इस्, इस्, इ, having rays of light gleam-
ing or playing.

वि-लसन, अम्, n. the act of flashing, gleaming,
sporting, dallying, play, sport.

वि-लासन, अम्, n. (perhaps for the more correct
form वि-लसन), sport, pastime, play, dalliance,
wantonness; fascination.

वि-लसित, अस्, आ, अम्, gleaming, glittering, shin-
ing, shining forth, appearing, appeared, manifested;
played, sported; sportive, wanton; (अम्), n. gleam-
ing, flashing; appearance, manifestation, (विद्या-व्˚,
manifestation of knowledge); a gleam, flash; sport,
play, pastime, dalliance, wanton gestures; a brilliant
action, action or gesture (in general).

वि-लासिका, f. a drama in one act on any light
subject or adventure.

वि-लासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wanton, sportive, coquettish,
playful, dallying; (ई), m. a sporter, voluptuary, sen-
sualist; fire; the moon; a snake; an epithet of
Viṣṇu; of Kṛṣṇa; of Śiva; of Kāma, god of
love; (इनी), f. a wanton woman, harlot; a coquettish
woman, any woman.
विलाता विलाता, f., Ved. a young girl (?).

विलिख् वि-लिख्, cl. 6. P. -लिखति, -लेखितुम्
(Ved. inf. -लिखस्), to scratch, scratch up, tear, tear
open, scarify, scrape, rub, rub against, touch, reach
to; to scratch in or on, make a furrow or mark,
make an incision, write, write down, delineate, paint:
Caus. -लेखयति, -यितुम्, to cause to scratch, cause
to write.

वि-लिखत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, scratching, tearing,
scraping, writing, &c.

वि-लिखन, अम्, n. the act of scratching, scraping,
writing, &c.
वि-लिखित, अस्, आ, अम्, scratched, scraped, scarified.
वि-लिख्य, ind. having scratched, having written, &c.

वि-लेखन, अम्, n. making an incision or mark
or furrow; dividing, splitting; digging, delving,
rooting up.

वि-लेखिन्, ई, इनी, इ, scratching, scraping, touching,
reaching.

विलिप् वि-लिप्, cl. 6. P. A. -लिम्पति, -ते,
-लेप्तुम्, to smear over, besmear, plaster, spread over,
anoint; to smear or spread on; to pollute: Pass.
-लिप्यते, to be anointed, be smeared over.

वि-लिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, smeared over, besmeared,
anointed, plastered, smeared.

वि-लिम्पित, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. the Caus.),
smeared over, besmeared.

वि-लेप, अस्, m. ointment, unguent, (especially
the fragrant unguent of sandal, agallochum, &c.);
anointing, plastering; mortar, plaster; (ई), f. rice-
gruel.

वि-लेपन, अम्, n. the act of smearing, anointing,
plastering over, smearing or anointing the body
(with fragrant oils, &c.); perfume for the person (as
unguent or oil of sandal, saffron, camphor, bdellium,
&c.); ointment of any kind; (ई), f. a woman
scented with perfumes, &c.; rice-gruel.

विलेपनिन्, ई, इनी, इ, possessing unguents or per-
fumes, (अ-विलेपनिन्, deprived of ointments.)
वि-लेपिका, f. rice-gruel.

वि-लेपिन्, ई, इनी, इ, smearing or plastering over,
one who anoints, &c.

वि-लेप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be spread over or plastered;
(अस्), m. rice-gruel.
विलिश् वि-लिश् = वि-रिश्, q. v.
वि-लिष्ट = वि-रिष्ट.

विलिस्तेङ्गा विलिस्तेङ्गा, f., N. of a Dānavī
(of whom Indra was enamoured).

विलिह् वि-लिह्, cl. 2. P. A. -लेढि, -लीढे,
-लेढुम्, to lick, lick up, lap.

वि-लेलिहत्, अत्, अती, अत् (Intens. pres. part.; in
Mahā-bh. Śānti-p. 8075. वि-लेलिहन्, nom. case
masc.), licking continually.

वि-लेलिहान, अस्, आ, अम्, continually or repeatedly
licking.

विली वि-ली, cl. 4. A. -लीयते, -लातुम् or -ले-
तुम्, to cling to, lie close to, stick to, cleave to, be
united or addicted or attached to; to settle on, alight
or perch on; to become disunited or dissolved, be-
come liquid, melt away; to become dissipated or
dispersed, become ineffectual; to fall to pieces, be
destroyed, perish, vanish, disappear, become hidden;
cl. 1. P. -लयति, to make liquid or fluid, melt:
Caus. -लीनयति, -लापयति, -लालयति, -लाययति,
(according to some grammarians this last is the form
to be used when not speaking of liquefying butter or
similar substances, see Pāṇ.

), -यितुम्, to
cause to become disunited or dissolved, cause to be
dissolved in (with loc.); to make liquid, dissolve,
melt; to cause to vanish or disappear, destroy.

वि-लयन, अम्, n. the act of dissolving, liquefy-
ing, dissolution, liquefaction, destroying; corroding,
eating away; removing, taking away; attenuating;
an attenuant, escharotic (in medicine).

वि-लाप्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being caused to be
dissolved, being liquefied.

वि-लायम्, ind. becoming dissolved, melting away,
becoming dispersed, (अभ्र-विलायम्, in the manner
of the dissolving of a cloud, Kirāt.
XI. 79

वि-लायित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), made liquid,
dissolved, melted.

वि-लीन, अस्, आ, अम्, clinging to, sticking or cleav-
ing to, attached to, addicted to, immersed in; settled
on, alighting on [cf. शाखा-व्˚]; contiguous to, in
[]
contact with, united or blended with; infused into
the mind, imagined; dissolved, liquid, liquefied,
melted, semifluid (as melted oil or butter, &c.);
disappeared, perished, vanished.
—विलीन-षट्पद,
अस्, आ, अम्, having bees clinging or attached.

वि-लीय, ind. having settled down, having become
dissolved, having disappeared.

वि-लीयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, clinging to, settling; be-
coming dissolved, liquefying.

वि-लीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being dissolved or
melted, &c., disappearing, being hidden.

विलुञ्च् वि-लुञ्च्, cl. 1. P. -लुञ्चति, -लुञ्चितुम्,
to tear off, tear out, pluck off, tear to pieces.
वि-लुञ्चन, अम्, n. the act of tearing off.

विलुठ् वि-लुठ्, cl. 6. P. -लुठति, -लुठितुम्,
to roll, roll or move about, move to and fro, quiver,
flicker; to agitate, move, stir, rouse, excite.

वि-लुठत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, rolling, moving to
and fro, sparkling.
वि-लुठित, अस्, आ, अम्, agitated, excited.

विलुड् वि-लुड् (closely connected with वि-
लुल्), Caus. -लोडयति, &c., to agitate, stir about,
stir up, rouse, move to and fro, toss about; to turn
over, upset; to disarrange, disturb, disorder, confuse,
throw into disorder or confusion.

वि-लोडन, अम्, n. the act of agitating, shaking,
stirring, churning, rolling, tossing.

विलोडन वि-लोडन, &c. See under वि-लुड्,
col. 2.
वि-लोडयितृ, ता, m. an agitator, disturber.

वि-लोड्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being agitated, being
stirred about or up, being tossed about; being thrown
into disorder, being disarranged.

विलुण्ट्य वि-लुण्ट्य, ind. having taken
away, having taken off the husk, (in Pañca-tantra,
p. 121, 13, a better reading has लुञ्चित्वा.)

विलुण्ठ् वि-लुण्ठ्, cl. 1. P. -लुण्ठति, -लुण्-
ठितुम्, to carry off, rob, plunder, steal: Pass.
-लुण्ठ्यते, to be plundered or ravaged.
वि-लुण्ठन, अम्, n. the act of plundering, robbing.

वि-लुण्ठित, अस्, आ, अम्, robbed, plundered, pil-
laged; rolled or rolling about (= वि-लुठित).

विलुप् वि-लुप्, cl. 6. P. A. -लुम्पति, -ते,
-लोप्तुम्, to tear or break off, cut off; to tear or
break to pieces, pull out or up; to tear or carry
away, carry off, ravish, seize, plunder, rob, pillage;
to destroy, confound, ruin; to fall to pieces, be
ruined (A.): Pass. -लुप्यते, to be torn away or
carried off, be plundered, be destroyed, perish, be
lost, disappear, fail: Caus. -लोपयति, -यितुम्, to
tear or carry away, withhold, keep back; to cause to
disappear, destroy, ruin, oppress, extinguish.

वि-लुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, torn off or away, broken off,
broken; carried off or away, snatched away, seized,
taken, plundered, robbed; destroyed, ruined, lost;
impaired, mutilated.

वि-लुम्पक, अस्, इका, अम्, one who breaks or cuts
off; one who seizes or robs; a robber, ravisher.

वि-लुम्पत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, tearing or pluck-
ing off, tearing, &c.
विलोप वि-लोप, &c. See under वि-लुप्.

वि-लोपन, अम्, n. the act of tearing or breaking
to pieces, cutting off, destroying, destruction.

वि-लोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, torn away, broken, ruined,
destroyed, oppressed, extinguished, put out.

विलुभ् वि-लुभ्, cl. 4. P. -लुभ्यति, -लोभि-
तुम् or -लोब्धुम्, to become disordered or disar-
ranged, fall into disorder or confusion: Caus. -लोभ-
यति, -यितुम्, to lead astray, perplex, confuse; to
allure, entice, tempt; to divert, amuse, delight.

वि-लुभित, अस्, आ, अम्, disordered, disarranged,
disturbed, agitated, bewildered; tossed or shaken
about.
—विलुभित-प्लव, अस्, आ, अम्, going in an
agitated manner.
वि-लोभ, अस्, m. attraction, delusion, seduction.
विलोभ वि-लोभ, &c. See under वि-लुभ्.

वि-लोभन, अम्, n. the act of leading astray, per-
plexing, beguiling; allurement, attraction, temptation,
seduction; flattering, praise, commendation (especially
by contrast with inferiority).

वि-लोभयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, alluring, enticing;
diverting, amusing, delighting.

वि-लोभित, अस्, आ, अम्, allured, beguiled; deceived;
flattered, praised.

वि-लोभ्य, ind. having enticed or beguiled, having
fascinated, &c.

वि-लोभ्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being allured or en-
ticed, being fascinated, being overcome.

विलुल् वि-लुल् (closely connected with वि-
लुड्), cl. 1. P. -लोलति, &c., to move or roll about;
to become disarranged or confused: Caus. -लोलयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to move or roll about, agitate, dis-
turb.

वि-लुलित, अस्, आ, अम्, moved hither and thither;
shaken down, falling down, rolling down; shaken,
shaking about, agitated, waving, tremulous, unsteady,
fickle; disordered, disarranged.
—विलुलितालक (˚त-
अल्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having disordered or dishevelled
locks.

वि-लोल, अस्, आ, अम्, moving or shaking about;
shaking, trembling, tremulous, fickle, unsteady, loose;
rolling (as the eye), rolling or tossing about, waving.
—विलोल-ता, f. or विलोल-त्व, अम्, n. tremulousness,
unsteadiness; rolling (of the eyes).
—विलोल-हार,
अस्, आ, अम्, having necklaces tossing about.
विलोल वि-लोल, वि-लोलित, &c. See p. 938.

वि-लोलन, अम्, n. the act of shaking; stirring,
agitating.

वि-लोलित, अस्, आ, अम्, moved hither and thither,
shaken about, agitated, tossed about.
—विलोलित-दृश्,
क्, क्, क्, rolling the eyes, having tremulous eyes.

विलून वि-लून, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, cut asunder,
cut off, cut, (Pāṇ.
Vārtt. 3

विलोक् वि-लोक्, cl. 1. A. -लोकते, -लोकितुम्,
to look at or upon, regard; to examine, test, study;
cl. 10. P. or Caus. -लोकयति, -यितुम्, to look at,
look on or upon, look towards, behold, regard, ob-
serve, consider, examine; to perceive, see, discover,
be aware of; to look over or beyond (with acc.):
Pass. -लोक्यते, to be seen, be visible.

वि-लोकन, अम्, n. the act of looking or regarding,
discerning, seeing, spying; sight, observation.

वि-लोकनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked at; worthy
of being looked at, agreeable, beautiful.
—विलोकनीय-
ता, f. or विलोकनीय-त्व, अम्, n. a state worthy of
being looked at, loveliness, beauty.

वि-लोकयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, looking at, seeing; dis-
cerning.

वि-लोकित, अस्, आ, अम्, looked at, beheld, seen,
observed, regarded, examined, contemplated; (अम्),
n. a look, glance.

विलोक वि-लोक, अस्, आ, अम्, apart from the
world, solitary, lonely.

विलोचन वि-लोचन, अम्, n. the eye, sight.
—विलोचन-पात, अस्, m. a cast or glance of the
eye, a glance, look.
—विलोचनाम्बु (˚न-अम्˚), उ,
n. ‘eye-water,’ tears.

विलोटक वि-लोटक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. लुट् with
वि), a sort of fish, Clupea Cultrata (= नल-मीन).

विलोम वि-लोम, अस्, ई, अम्, against the hair,
against the grain, out of the usual or proper course,
reverse, inverted, inverse, turned the wrong way,
turned backward, contrary, opposite; produced in
the reverse order [cf. विलोम-ज]; (अस्), m. reverse
[]
order, opposite course, reverse; a snake; a dog; an
epithet of Varuṇa (the regent of the waters); (अम्),
n. a water-wheel or machine for raising water from
a well (= अर-घट्टक); (ई), f. Emblic Myrobalan.
—विलोम-क्रिया, f. reverse action, doing anything
in reverse order or backwards; (in arithmetic) rule of
inversion.
—विलोम-ज or विलोम-जात, अस्, आ, अम्,
‘born out of the proper course or in the reverse
order,’ i. e. one whose father and mother have their
stations reversed, the father being of an inferior caste
and the mother of a superior.
—विलोम-जिह्व, अस्,
m. an elephant (as having a tongue which moves
backwards ?).
—विलोम-त्रैराशिक, अम्, n. rule of
three inverse.
—विलोम-वर्ण, अस्, m. ‘of reverse
caste,’ a man of mixed or inferior birth, (see विलोम-
ज above.)
—विलोम-विधि, इस्, m. an inverted rite,
reversed ceremony; (in arithmetic) rule of inversion.
—विलोमाक्षर-काव्य (˚म-अक्˚), अम्, n. a poem
which may be read either backwards or forwards; =
राम-कृष्ण-काव्य, q. v.
—विलोमोत्पन्न (˚म-
उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, = विलोम-ज above.

वि-लोमित, अस्, आ, अम्, reversed, inverted, made
averse or disaffected.

विलोहित वि-लोहित, अस्, आ, अम्, of a deep-red
or purple colour; (अस्), m. epithet of Rudra and Fire
(as identified with Rudra); (आ), f. (according to
some), epithet of one of the tongues of fire; [cf. सु-
लोहित.]

विल्व विल्व, अस्, m. (fr. rt. विल्, also written
बिल्व, q. v.), the tree Ægle Marmelos (commonly
called Bel); (अम्), n. the fruit of the Bel; a particu-
lar weight, (see बिल्व.) For the compounds of विल्व
see बिल्व.
